production_domain.encoded_video: sRGB OETF pixels, BT.709 primaries/matrix, limited range
production_domain.scope: Behavioural baseline and quality reference only. Do not use as a numeric oracle for the Adobe DNG Converter / DNG SDK / ACEScg chain: the two chains do not promise pixel equality.

render_temporal_quality.note: legacy frozen-target check is self-consistent with whatever correction was proposed; independent render-domain targets are tracked separately

baseline_exposure_policy.note: owner 'none' means the backend provably ignores the tag; the project does not silently add it

gain_probe.reason: disabled, short sequence or no reliable exposures

gain_response.reason: disabled, short sequence or no reliable exposures

cross_boundary_anchors.method: whole-frame all-valid-tile median level const across the boundary (owner whole-sequence intent: perceived overall brightness stays continuous); explicit assumption, not evidence

warnings: DNG_BASELINE_EXPOSURE_IGNORED_BY_BACKEND: per-frame default-development exposure metadata is not executed by this backend build (probe-verified); interpretation policy is explicit, never double-applied
DNG_OPCODE_LIST3_NOT_APPLIED: GainMap/WarpRectilinear payloads present in the files are not executed by this backend build (probe-verified)
REVIEW_REQUIRED: one or more frames have no reliable EV estimate
